title: Weekend Recovery Hydration Gap
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hydration:intake
| eval day_type=if(match(strftime(_time,"%w"),"0|6"),"weekend","weekday")
| stats avg(ml) as avg_ml, avg(goal_pct) as avg_goal_pct by day_type
description: Compares whether hydration collapses on weekends, when routines and recovery needs often change most.
value: Weekend habits often explain why Monday feels rough even when weekdays look disciplined.
implementation: Track water intake and goal percentage in `index=personal`; compare average hydration by weekend versus weekday.
visualization: Two-bar comparison of weekday and weekend hydration.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether weekends quietly wreck your hydration even when weekdays look under control.
